zoning_districts.accuracy: Zoning-district boundaries are approximate: the DCP horizontal accuracy statement is approximately ± 20 ft, so a boundary drawn near the lot is not a lot-level determination.
zoning_districts.use_limitation: These features are not intended for determining zoning at the individual tax lot level.
